qualification: Native ARM build, nonroot read-only import/artifact execution, and exact installed-image scans are required; base/image metadata alone does not qualify a release.

bundledUndici.qualification: Complete official package replacement only; npm 12.2.1 upstream is unchanged otherwise and has not released this fix. Build compares every other npm file against its original tarball and verifies the replacement bytes, node-gyp resolution and declared semver range.

rendererProvenance.qualification: Unqualified source installation pins. Exact ARM image must pass observed no-network/non-root/read-only/no-credentials/limited child sandbox and Office/PDF corpus acceptance before renderer availability.

retainedSignedIndex.trustRoot: the vendor RSA public keys already installed in the pinned base keyring; apk verifies this index signature with them before it will select any package from the repository
retainedSignedIndex.verified: measured with the base apk-tools against this index staged as a local repository: the untampered index resolves offline (104542 distinct packages available) and a one-record, format-valid tamper of the index payload is refused with "BAD signature"; a byte-flipped package file is refused on the index-recorded package identity, and a package whose archive is not staged fails closed with "package mentioned in index not found"
retainedSignedIndex.note: Retained verbatim as the repository index and committed under infra/product-preview/native-apk-index. It is the trust root for the staged archives, so no live index is consulted and no .apk file is passed to apk as a local path.

uploadNativeProvenance.note: The Wolfi APKINDEX is a rolling live file, so the frozen index hash above is only a per-retrieval audit record; the pinned .apk archives are the authoritative immutable artifacts. Every recorded .apk sha256 was computed from the downloaded official archive, and every download length matched the index S: field exactly.
uploadNativeProvenance.closure: The whole transitive native closure of the seven upload archives (and of the python and renderer layers) is staged inside one local apk repository: 190 official aarch64 archives pinned by exact URL and sha256 in the Dockerfile ADD --checksum list and in systemPackages, beside the retained vendor-signed index recorded above. The three native layers install with `apk add --no-cache --no-network --repository /tmp/meri-native-repo --update-cache <name>=<version>`, so apk admits every archive through that index signature and its recorded package identity and never through a local file path or --allow-untrusted. This corrects the earlier claim that the previous 88-archive closure installed from local paths: the exact locked command `apk add --no-cache --no-network <pinned archives>` fails with UNTRUSTED signature exit 99, and the previous closure was also incomplete (apk resolves 175 members for these layers; 91 further official archives were added here). The engine library itself moves with the release: so:libclamav.so.12 is provided by clamav-1.5 1.5.2-r7 (the approved scanner binaries stay at the pinned 1.5.2-r0), and the Wolfi clamav-1.5 package hard-depends on clamav-1.5-daemon/-milter/-clamdscan/-db/-libunrar, so those binaries are installed but nothing configures or starts a daemon and no clamd.conf exists.

declaredFinalVersions.note: The intended FINAL versions of the shared C++ runtime in the built image, so the two layers' package statements are one truthful declaration instead of an implicit supersession. Nothing here is an observed installed fact: no image has been built, pulled or inspected.

superseded.name: libstdc++
superseded.declaredBy: Dockerfile renderer layer (apk add ... libstdc++=16.2.0-r1), left byte-identical as an immutable prior pin

supersededBy.name: libstdc++
supersededBy.installedBy: Dockerfile upload layer, closure archive libstdc++-16.2.0-r2.apk

declaredFinalVersions.assertedBy: the upload layer's apk info -v loop names libstdc++-16.2.0-r2, libgcc-16.2.0-r2 and libatomic-16.2.0-r1, and rejects a surviving libstdc++-16.2.0-r1
declaredFinalVersions.unverified: Whether the resulting triple is ABI-correct for the renderer and for the upload tools is native qualification (an actual ARM build plus observed execution), not established here.

baseInstalledSet.statement: The base image's own installed package set is UNOBSERVED: no pull, manifest inspection or in-image apk info was performed, and no base-installed version is claimed here. The intended effect of this delta is an UPGRADE of the shared C++ runtime to the index-newest revisions the closure pins (libstdc++ 16.2.0-r2, libgcc 16.2.0-r2) while libatomic stays at its approved 16.2.0-r1 pin.
baseInstalledSet.failClosed: Because every upload-layer install names exact archive files, a base digest that already carried a newer revision of any named package makes apk add refuse the older explicit file: the build fails closed instead of silently drifting to a different version.

uploadNativeProvenance.pythonWheels: The upload parser imports pypdf, openpyxl, lxml and Pillow; all four are already pinned in infra/product-preview/runtime-wheels.lock.json and installed by the existing pip layer (pypdf 6.21.2, openpyxl 3.1.5, lxml 6.1.3, pillow 13.0.0). No new wheel record is required.
uploadNativeProvenance.qualification: Unqualified source installation pins. The exact ARM image must pass the observed no-network/non-root/read-only/no-credentials/limited child sandbox, real ClamAV/Tesseract/Poppler versions and a representative scanned/Office/PDF corpus before any upload native availability claim.
